BPMN Gateways

General Concept: BPMN Gateways are elements that control the routing, condition evaluation, and synchronization of process flows, such as Exclusive, Inclusive, Parallel, and Event-Based Gateways. These elements ensure that process paths are selected and joined according to BPMN semantics and engine configuration.

Usage & Options in TaktX:
BPMN Gateways in TaktX:

  • Control process routing and synchronization, enabling complex workflow logic.
  • Support condition evaluation using FEEL expressions for exclusive and inclusive gateways.
  • Synchronize parallel flows, ensuring all required paths are completed before continuing.
  • Enable event-driven routing for event-based gateways, waiting for triggers before proceeding.
  • Provide hooks for monitoring, audit logging, and integration with external systems.
  • Are specialized into exclusive, inclusive, parallel, and event-based types, each with unique options.

 

  • Exclusive Gateway
  • Inclusive Gateway
  • Parallel Gateway
  • Event-Based Gateway
